entries.title: Romans 6:1
segments: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin so that grace may abound?

entries.title: Romans 6:2
segments: Let it not be! How shall we who died to sin live any longer in it?

entries.title: Romans 6:3
segments: Do you not know that as many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into His death?

entries.title: Romans 6:4
segments: Therefore we were buried with Him by baptism into death, so that as Christ was raised up from [the] dead by the glory of the Father; even so we also should walk in newness of life.

entries.title: Romans 6:5
segments: For if we have been joined together in the likeness of His death, we shall also be [in the likeness] of His resurrection;

entries.title: Romans 6:6
segments: knowing this, that our old man is crucified with [Him] in order that the body of sin might be destroyed, that from now on we should not serve sin.

entries.title: Romans 6:7
segments: For he who died has been justified from sin.

entries.title: Romans 6:8
segments: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with Him,

entries.title: Romans 6:9
segments: knowing that when Christ was raised from [the] dead, He dies no more; death no longer has dominion over Him.

entries.title: Romans 6:10
segments: For in that He died, He died to sin once; but in that He lives, He lives to God.

entries.title: Romans 6:11
segments: Likewise count yourselves also to be truly dead to sin, but alive to God through Jesus Christ our Lord.

entries.title: Romans 6:12
segments: Therefore do not let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.

entries.title: Romans 6:13
segments: Do not yield your members [as] instruments of unrighteousness to sin, but yield yourselves to God, as [one] alive from [the] dead, and your members [as] instruments of righteousness to God.

entries.title: Romans 6:14
segments: For sin shall not have dominion over you, for you are not under Law, but under grace.

entries.title: Romans 6:15
segments: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under Law, but under grace? Let it not be!

entries.title: Romans 6:16
segments: Do you not know that to whom you yield yourselves [as] slaves for obedience, you are slaves to him whom you obey; whether it is of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness.

entries.title: Romans 6:17
segments: But thanks [be] to our God that you were the slaves of sin, but you have obeyed from [the] heart that form of doctrine to which you were delivered.

entries.title: Romans 6:18
segments: Then being made free from sin, you became the slaves of righteousness.

entries.title: Romans 6:19
segments: I speak in the manner of men because of the weakness of your flesh; for as you have yielded your members [as] slaves to uncleanness, and to lawless act unto lawless act, even so now yield your members as slaves to righteousness unto holiness.

entries.title: Romans 6:20
segments: For when you were the slaves of sin, you were free from righteousness.

entries.title: Romans 6:21
segments: What fruit did you have then [in those things] of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things [is] death.

entries.title: Romans 6:22
segments: But now, being made free from sin, and having become slaves to God, you have your fruit to holiness, and the end everlasting life.

entries.title: Romans 6:23
segments: For the wages of sin [is] death, but the gift of God [is] eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
